tokenAmount.why: 10% of the 1M TKN treasury, the amount to sell.

stableAmount.why: Matches the token side by value so the anchor stays thick.

price.why: No price given; kept the form's current opening price.

tickSpacing.why: The usual spacing; nothing asked for otherwise.

rangePct.why: Default width, comfortably covers the 300-tick half-width.

positionPct.why: Default: half of each side starts in the position.

anchorPct.why: A little above 20% to clear the 19% anchor minimum.

auctionHours.why: One day of bidding, usual for a real mandate.

minBond.why: You asked for a bond of at least 25k.

twapMins.why: Default window, hard to push for a mid-size pool.

startStablePct.why: The deposit opens at 50% stablecoin; a little headroom.

endStablePct.why: All 100k TKN may be sold into USDC by the end.

assumptions: The opening price stays at 2 USDC per TKN.
The deposit is the 100k TKN to sell plus 200k USDC to pair it.
Weekly epochs, so the quarter is 12 of them.
questions: Which addresses are TKN and USDC on this network? The form keeps the ones already filled in.
Is 2 USDC the market price today?
